candidates.statement: in [@LeungLi2012] is their "quantum equals classical" result. It states that if $N^{w, \alpha}_{u,v(\lambda,k)}\neq 0$, then there exist $w',u'\in S_n$ such that $N^{w, \alpha}_{u,v(\lambda,k)}=N^{w', {{\mathbf 0}}}_{u',v(\lambda,k)}= c^{w'}_{u',v(\lambda,k)}$. A consequence of their proof is that $w u^{-1}=w'(u')^{-1}$, but we require more than that. We state and prove the result we will need; this is extracted from the proof of Theorem 1.2 in [@LeungLi2012].
